exposure: gestational carrier (GC) in vitro fertilization (IVF) cycles
Spontaneous cycles in the same gestational carriers
outcome: Composite score for adverse perinatal outcomes
cohort: 78 gestational carriers who underwent IVF cycles for same-sex or single male intended parents and 71 spontaneous cycles by the same gestational carriers
finding: Commissioned IVF cycles in gestational carriers were significantly associated with an increased incidence of adverse perinatal outcomes and lower average gestational age compared to spontaneous pregnancies in the same gestational carriers.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in the incidence of vaginal deliveries or cesarean sections between commissioned and spontaneous cycles.
